questions.question: How did the people respond to the spies' report?
options: They drove out the unfaithful spies
They armed themselves at once to take the land
They wept and wanted to return to Egypt
They fell down and worshiped the LORD
questions.answer: They wept and wanted to return to Egypt

questions.question: What was God's judgment on that generation?
options: They would be sent back into slavery in Egypt
They would be scattered among the nations
They would wander forty years and not enter the land
They would all die by plague within a year
questions.answer: They would wander forty years and not enter the land

questions.question: Only Caleb and Joshua of that generation would enter the promised land.
Israel would wander in the wilderness _____ years, one for each day the spies explored.
Of that generation, only _____ and Joshua would enter the land.
